Post-quantum schemes carry the mathematical family they rest on and where each stands, so SIKE reports as broken and HAWK as withdrawn rather than as "PQC". Every file is accounted for as scanned, unreadable, or skipped by type, so the coverage figure has a denominator. Zero outbound connections, no account, no API key — enforced by a test.
